title: CreateLaunch
description: Body of POST /campaigns/{campaignId}/launch. campaignId is in the path, never in the body.
x-serverSideChecks: displayName is only a SUGGESTION: a value that fails the naming policy is dropped, the launch still succeeds

segments: every element must be a slug (lower-case words joined by single hyphens, at most 40 characters); one wrong element refuses the whole call with 400 and creates no ticket; at most 10 distinct slugs per call (duplicates are dropped before counting)
segments: a well-formed slug that Diso has not declared for YOUR integration (or has archived) does NOT fail the call: the launch succeeds and that group is simply not applied

segments only ever ADD groups to the player: absent, null and [] change nothing, and no launch can remove a group; a player carries at most 30 groups, and a call that would pass 30 adds none of its new groups
